glossary.definition: (A) "Housing project" means any work or undertaking of a housing authority pursuant to sections 3735.27 to 3735.50 , inclusive, of the Revised Code, or any similar work or undertaking of the federal government.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3735.51 to 3735.57 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "State public body" means any township, county, municipal corporation, commission, district, authority, other subdivision, or public body of this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3735.51 to 3735.57 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Governing body" means the council, board of commissioners, or other body having charge of the fiscal affairs of the state public body.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3735.51 to 3735.57 , inclusive, of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Federal government" means the United States, the federal works administrator, or any other agency or instrumentality, corporate or otherwise, of the United States.
